name: Library Select
description: Lets editors select which registered asset libraries to attach per node/entity.
project_description:
Library Select 

 Module allow quick and easy insert CSS/JS code and files to Drupal.

Library Select allow you create a field in your content type and Editor can easy select predefined CSS/JS Code.

 Configuration 

Configuration URL: admin/config/development/library_select_entity

 This module support The CodeMirror Editor integration.

 Context 

There is sub module library_select_context integrate with Context module allow you can easy attach library to any page with context rules.

 Attach library with Views 

You can use module Views Attach Library and add library to view with format 'library_select/{machine_name}', with {machine_name} is your library select machine_name.
